in_marathi.name: Dheeran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheeran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhira’, meaning ‘fearless, brave, and wise’, Dheeran is a powerful and evocative Hindu name that reflects the strength and courage of its bearer. In Hindu mythology, Dheeran is the name of a king or a warrior, who is revered for his unwavering determination and unyielding spirit. The name carries an aura of nobility and valor, inspiring respect and admiration from those around him.
